labels.label: lem:spread_top
labels.notes: GX.spread_top_of_local is the form DEC-80(c) accepts, word for word: N -> M Galoisian (hq), p^-1(R) connected (hRc), StrongLocallyConnectedOrd (hH). The other hypotheses are the printed ones: M T2/FC/connected/LPC, S skeletal, M\S slsc in M (hrel), T <= tN, T FC/LPC, Gamma(N/M) T-continuous, R in ord_p T-portly, agreement on R. The two disclosed readings are covered by rulings: hSc (M\S slsc as a space, the presupposition of M~^S) by DEC-79(a)/DEC-80(c), and N T2/LPC/FC by DEC-66(a). The conclusion carries all five clauses (a)-(e) for p^*T, with (d) over deckGroup(SpreadEnd.base) = Gamma(M~^S/M). StrongLocallyConnectedOrd is a hypothesis equivalent to (c) (isPortly_strongPullTop_iff_local), and the ruling accepts it explicitly, so it is not a hidden-conclusion defect. Both counterexamples to the printed form (half-cut, sector) are kept and recorded. The mark is justified.

labels.label: rem:hypothesis_model_spaces_necessary
labels.notes: GX.hypothesis_model_spaces_necessary holds for every alpha > 0 with alpha != 2*pi, on the remark's own instance: the massive particle MassCyl alpha, the spinless family of DEC-74 with DEC-47's developing map, and a structure that exists (exists_isMassiveStructure). It proves: sing = axis; tame; Phi : M~ ~= D_inf x R over E_alpha; three topologies tamifying, namely the natural one, the BTZ T as printed (btzGenTop = tE inf generateFrom{r theta^2 < l}, with hornTop_eq_btzGenTop proved) and T' = mixedTop T {t>0} (the remark's 'generated by the natural one and T|{t>0}', pullTamTop_eq_mixedTop); Gamma preserves T' (item (C)); a time translation in aeAutMapsMax that is T-continuous and not T'-continuous. IsTamifyingTopology (A)-(D) is proved directly for any Phi over the base, so the remark's unproved 'T' is again tamifying' is now built. There is no vacuity: every hypothesis is satisfiable.

labels.label: rem:intuitively_spread_thinner_than
labels.notes: Read literally the remark is false: not_isSpread_strongPullTop_ratTop, and not_isGreatest_strongPullTop_unrestricted for the unrestricted comparison. The general facts are le_strongPullTop_of_isSpread and isSpread_strongPullTop_iff. In the lemma's ruled setting the intuition holds: intuitively_spread_thinner_of_local gives IsGreatest among the topologies finer than the natural one. The 'However' sentence is cex_component_not_strongPull_connected. Under DEC-27 the row is correctly partial, with a ruling question asked.

labels.label: rem:quotient_virtually_tame
labels.notes: GX.quotient_virtually_tame_galoisian' proves the remark for a Galoisian N, which is DEC-71's reading of the twin remark at l.1869. That ruling has not been extended to l.2154, so partial is correct and the question to the master is asked. 'Isomorphic' is read as homeomorphic and this is disclosed. There is no vacuity: the hypotheses are the remark's own plus the DEC-66 standing ones.

labels.label: def:topological_spaces_continuous_map
labels.audit: agree on content; attribution is a curation question
labels.notes: Models defines GX.strongPullTop as tE inf generateFrom{components of p^-1(O), O in T} and marks it. That is faithful: generated by T_M and those components, with no continuity of p needed. This file adds strongPullTop_eq_generateFrom_union, the verbatim 'generated by' form, plus API. The REPORT correctly says the row belongs to Models and removes the mark here.
